turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Sam calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Joel Forbes?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: this still the best number to reach you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, this is my cell.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $528.82.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can't pay the whole thing. I'm waiting on EI, I applied 4 weeks ago.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To set that up I'll need a quick look your monthly budget. What are your main fixed expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly rent, groceries and the car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team will follow up with the details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay $238 Jun 12.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $237.97 on June 12. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How would you like to make that payment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Online banking is easiest.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's all.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
